interpretation: A broad primary and a variable secondary shoulder recur at the 0.58053-day cycle. ZTF g and r confirm periodic fading. The light curves and prior miscellaneous-variable classification leave rotating spots plausible.
prior_evidence: Earlier public TESS-SPOC full-frame threshold-crossing events

title: The SDSS-HET Survey of Kepler Eclipsing Binaries: Spectroscopic Dynamical Masses of the Kepler-16 Circumbinary Planet Hosts
